activation_preconditions: Canonical T119 exists and the full repository verification gate passes
Generator and verifier implementations pass the controller-owned TEST_PLAN.md
Controller freezes an external noncircular spec/plan binding and CAS policy
The operator records a go decision after all trust gates pass
index_semantics: Record N uses the T118 normalized data for sampledBBPOrbit (N+1)

rules: n is a JSON integer and indexes the T118 successor N+1
r and w are canonical nonnegative decimal strings with no leading zero except 0
cell is the JSON integer Int.ediv (10*r) w; the routes prove 0<=cell<10
cell is never computed with %10, floating point, or decimal approximation

window_statistics.j: J=sum(c=0..9,n_c^2), the ordered same-cell pair count including all 256 diagonal pairs and both orientations
window_statistics.strict_test_field: j10_strict_pass is a JSON boolean equal to the strict test

lag_counts.schema: an array ordered by lag of exactly 255 objects for l=1..255 with exact keys lag,same_cell_count,near_determinant_count,zero_determinant_count; C_0 is the controller-derived constant 256 and is not an array record

rules: num and den are canonical decimal strings; other fields are JSON integers
num and den are the exact raw formula values, den>0, num<den, lag=witness_m-witness_n
it is the exact maximum by cross multiplication with no floating point
only distinct same-cell pairs N<M are eligible; diagonal pairs are omitted

canonical_bytes.json: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=true, exactly one trailing LF
canonical_bytes.integer_strings: 0 or -?[1-9][0-9]* as permitted by the field; no plus sign or leading zeros
canonical_bytes.rejection: reject parsed-equivalent bytes, floats, NaN, Infinity, duplicate keys, extra keys, or noncanonical strings

trust_boundary.source_separation: generator and verifier are disjoint source trees and may share only these frozen specification files and primitive JSON schema literals
trust_boundary.arithmetic_separation: generator uses one exact recurrence route; verifier independently reconstructs every T118 point and statistic using a separately owned route
trust_boundary.execution: separate networkless read-only pods with bounded writable scratch; neither sees the other's source
trust_boundary.cas: controller hashes accepted canonical raw bytes with SHA-256 and stores them by digest; candidate paths and claimed hashes are never trusted
trust_boundary.receipt: controller emits a receipt only after independent verification, binding experiment_id, spec_bundle_sha256, window index/range, artifact_sha256, generator_source_sha256, verifier_source_sha256, verifier_result, and controller_gate_id
trust_boundary.aggregation: aggregate accepts only controller CAS digests and receipts, never candidate VERIFIED text or candidate manifests

hash_binding.policy: CONTRACT.json, INTERFACE.md, and TEST_PLAN.md contain no self-hash
hash_binding.external_binding: after review, the controller writes a separate immutable binding over the exact raw SHA-256 of each file plus experiment_id
hash_binding.spec_bundle: spec_bundle_sha256 is derived from the ordered file-name/raw-digest pairs and is not stored inside any hashed specification file
hash_binding.plan_binding: implementation plan/source hashes are controller-added after source delivery and cannot be candidate-authored or circular

production_order.rule: window 13 must generate and verify without any lower-window artifact present

derived_thresholds.strict_test_equivalent: because J has the parity of 256, 9*J<65536 is equivalent to J<=7280 and C_sum<=3512

window_13_decision: STOP-invalid on any route, canonical-byte, T118, statistic-identity, or T119 mismatch
STOP-local-conjecture if 9*J>=65536; preserve the first exact failure without retuning
GO windows 0..12 if the strict J test passes and A_sum<=3512
if J passes but A_sum>3512, STOP the determinant-only route unless the operator freezes exactly one low-complexity BBP-specific refinement before opening any holdout window
production_order.full_run: operator-controlled after every implementation and trust test passes and the frozen window-13 decision rule records GO

nonclaims: A finite strict-test pass certifies all ten cells only in that checked window; it proves nothing beyond it.
A strict-test failure rejects the stronger diagnostic but does not imply that any cell is empty.
T119 bounds a conditional same-cell ratio; it does not prove same-cell existence, recurrence, multiplicity, or anti-concentration.
A_l and Z_l are finite all-pair diagnostics, not cross-window, sliding-window, recurrence, or asymptotic statements.
No occupancy beyond checked finite windows, density, cancellation, normality, decimal occurrence, V1, or Pi resolution is claimed.
